name: Instrument & Counterparty Integrity Agent
description: v1 (financial instruments module): validates SWIFT MT structural fields, ISIN/CUSIP checksums, and scores submissions against a fraud-typology library. Never auto-sets 'verified' — requires independent-channel human confirmation. Hard-blocks on high fraud-risk score or structural validation failure.
note_runtime: Deterministic checksum/regex validation, not an LLM call — no model dependency, no external inference runtime.
open_items: Human-review confirmation endpoint (sets 'verified' after independent-channel counterparty check) not yet built — this agent can only reach 'blocked' or 'pending_human_verification'
Typology library v1.0.0 seeded from demonstrated failure case, not yet cross-validated against FBI IC3 / FinCEN advisory datasets
SWIFT structural validation is field-presence only (v1) — full ISO 15022 grammar parsing is a v1.1 hardening item
Scoring thresholds (block_threshold: 50, review_threshold: 20) are unvalidated starting values — require calibration against real transaction history
